# 01-management

Plans, safety management, confirmation measures, regulatory strategy, upstream management and the decision register.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §4, IEC 62061 §5, IEC 61508-1 §6 and §8, IEC 62443-4-1 SM, Machinery Regulation Art. 25, ASPICE MAN.3/5.
